title: Macro Defect Inspection - Delamination Detection on ATL/LMS IPRO8
subtitle: Pre-Bonding Quality Validation for 45nm Node Manufacturing
author: Michael Torres

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system to detect and classify Delamination defects during pre-bonding inspection at the 45nm technology node. The test is conducted at Pyeongtaek Fab 2 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Delamination defects that are critical to yield at the 45nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the ATL/LMS IPRO8 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: ATL/LMS IPRO8
- Inspection Type: Macro Defect Inspection
- Target Defect: Delamination
- Process Step: Pre-Bonding
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 45nm
- Fab Location: Pyeongtaek Fab 2

This test case applies to all ATL/LMS IPRO8 systems deployed at Pyeongtaek Fab 2 for pre-bonding monitoring in the 45nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: ATL/LMS IPRO8
Software Version: v14.6.546
Recipe: MACRO_DEFECT_INSPECTION_45nm_PRE_BONDING
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: High (176 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.1μm
Edge Exclusion: 4mm
Sampling Plan: 5-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Macro Defect Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Delamination defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 45nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 44 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 96% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.0% for Macro Defect Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.94 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-12-16
Wafers Tested: 44
Total Defects Found: 3581
Defect Density: 1139.87 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 7.1%
Capture Rate: 96.5%
Test Duration: 197 minutes
System Uptime: 96.4%

Result Classification: PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The ATL/LMS IPRO8 demonstrated excellent performance in detecting Delamination at the 45nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Throughput metrics met production requirements without sensitivity compromise.

e) SECS/GEM communication was verified with zero packet loss during data transfer.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Test passed all acceptance criteria.
